description: This file defines the core class 'Smarty' for the Smarty templating engine, including configuration, variable management, resource handling, plugin registration, cache management, and rendering logic.

classes.name: Smarty
classes.description: Core class implementing Smarty template engine features including variable assignment, template rendering, plugin management, cache control, resource handling, and security features.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns template variables, either as key-value pairs or an array of multiple variables.

methods.name: assign_by_ref
methods.description: Assigns a template variable by reference.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends values to existing template variables.

methods.name: append_by_ref
methods.description: Appends a referenced value to a template variable.

methods.name: register_function
methods.description: Registers a custom PHP function for use in templates.

methods.name: unregister_function
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered template function.

methods.name: register_object
methods.description: Registers a PHP object to be used in templates.

methods.name: register_block
methods.description: Registers a block function for templates.

methods.name: register_compiler_function
methods.description: Registers a compiler function for templates.

methods.name: register_resource
methods.description: Registers a resource handler for template sources.

methods.name: register_outputfilter
methods.description: Registers an output filter for template output.

methods.name: clear_cache
methods.description: Clears cache for a specific template and cache id.

methods.name: is_cached
methods.description: Checks if a cache exists for a template.

methods.name: config_load
methods.description: Loads configuration values from a file.

methods.name: get_registered_object
methods.description: Returns a registered object by name.

methods.name: _get_plugin_filepath
methods.description: Gets the file path for a plugin.

methods.name: _is_compiled
methods.description: Checks if a template is already compiled.

methods.name: _get_compile_path
methods.description: Returns the compile path for a template.

methods.name: _fetch_resource_info
methods.description: Fetches resource info such as timestamp and source.

methods.name: _parse_resource_name
methods.description: Parses resource name to type and identifier.

methods.name: _read_file
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file.

methods.name: _get_auto_filename
methods.description: Generates an auto filename for templates.

methods.name: _unlink
methods.description: Deletes a file, possibly considering expiration time.

methods.name: _get_auto_id
methods.description: Generates an auto ID for resource handling.

methods.name: _process_compiled_include_callback
methods.description: Handles included templates in compiled form.

methods.name: _include
methods.description: Includes a PHP file, retaining $this context.
